evidenceNotes: HRD Korea identifies CIPA as China's EPS sending agency.
The 6th China Point System route is Manufacturing, General CBT and Point System.
Registration ran 2026-03-18 through 2026-08-07; test announcement was 2026-09-04; test period was 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-11.
HRD Korea's current test-center list contains multiple China centers; KEP keeps the cycle-specific Xinxian/Xinyang site separate from generic center listings.
China skills-test candidate-list entries dated 2026-09-30 exist, but their generic 1st/2nd labels are not automatically linked to the exact 6th Manufacturing cycle.
Cycle-specific fee, registration document checklist, final-result state and downstream medical/visa/departure exact rules remain HOLD.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Use the current China 6th Manufacturing notice for complete cycle-specific eligibility. Generic HRD EPS eligibility is preparation guidance only until locally verified.

stages.title: 6th Point System registration
stages.action: HRD Korea records the China 6th Manufacturing registration period as 2026-03-18 through 2026-08-07. This window is closed.

stages.title: Application / test fee
stages.action: KEP has not promoted an exact China 6th-cycle fee. The generic HRD visiting-registration US$28 baseline remains generic until a current China cycle-specific rule is verified.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Follow current China identity and anti-fraud instructions only. KEP does not import another country's biometric rules.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: The exact China 6th-cycle passport/photo/upload/payment checklist has not yet been reconstructed in KEP. Do not substitute generic or another-country file specifications.

stages.title: Test announcement / admission
stages.action: HRD Korea records 2026-09-04 as the official test announcement date for the China 6th Manufacturing Point System.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — 6th Point System
stages.action: The China 6th Manufacturing route is General CBT with Point System. HRD Korea records the test period as 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-11.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.action: HRD Korea's Point System policy requires skills testing for EPS-TOPIK passers. Public candidate-list entries for China were published on 2026-09-30, but KEP has not linked the generic China 1st/2nd entries conclusively to this exact 6th Manufacturing cycle.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: Do not infer final selection from the completed EPS-TOPIK period or generic skills-candidate entries. A current 6th Manufacturing final-result artifact must be verified first.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate China psychology stage is asserted from the verified sources. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology rules.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Use only current China EPS medical/provider guidance. Exact 6th-cycle provider, checklist and fee remain HOLD.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: After verified final selection, follow current China candidate-file instructions. Exact 6th-cycle documents and timing remain HOLD.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.action: Only officially qualified candidates proceed to employer selection. Private intermediaries cannot guarantee roster priority or placement.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for selection through the official EPS system. No private intermediary can guarantee a specific Korean employer.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected, follow current official China/EPS instructions for SLC review/signing and next steps.

stages.title: Post-SLC China requirements
stages.action: Follow current official instructions for medical follow-up, training, visa documents, payments and departure preparation.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use the current China/Korean-mission visa checklist and fees. Exact current 6th-cycle downstream details are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete only the official pre-departure training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers. Exact timing/location/fee remain current-notice specific.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow current China instructions only if a final health recheck is explicitly required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only after official contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete and the official departure process is issued.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
